<?php
class InvokeBase220 { public $tag=9; public function __invoke($saved,$ignored) { echo "INVOKE:",self::class,":",static::class,";"; return $saved; } public function __destruct() { echo "INVOKER-END;"; } } class InvokeChild220 extends InvokeBase220 {}
class Replacement220 { public $tag=1; public function __destruct() { echo "REPLACEMENT;"; } }
class Old220 { public function __destruct() { echo "OLD;"; } } class New220 { public function __destruct() { echo "NEW;"; } }
function install220() { $GLOBALS["receiver"]=new InvokeChild220; echo "INSTALL;"; return false; }
function shift220() { $GLOBALS["receiver"]=new Replacement220; $GLOBALS["argument"]=new New220; $GLOBALS["owner"]=null; echo "SHIFT;"; return false; }
class Magic220 { public function __call(string $name,array $arguments) { $GLOBALS["receiver"]=null; $GLOBALS["argument"]=null; echo ($arguments[0]===false && $arguments[1] instanceof Old220)?"HANDLER:OLD;":"BAD;"; return false; } public function __destruct() { echo "OWNER;"; } }
$receiver=null; $argument=new Old220; $owner=new Magic220; $result=$owner->MiSsInG(install220(),($receiver(...))($argument,shift220())); echo "RETURN;"; echo $result===false?"AFTER;":"BAD;";

<?php
class Zero220 { public function __invoke() { $GLOBALS["receiver"]=null; echo "ZERO;"; return 7; } public function __destruct() { echo "ZERO-END;"; } }
class MagicZero220 { public function __call(string $name,array $arguments) { echo $arguments[0]===7?"HANDLER;":"BAD;"; return false; } }
$receiver=new Zero220; $owner=new MagicZero220; $result=$owner->MiSsInG(($receiver(...))()); echo "RETURN;"; echo $result===false?"AFTER;":"BAD;";
